extraction_method.caption_policy: Transcribe only text visibly present in the screenshots. Preserve paragraph order, informal spelling, English code-switching, capitalization, punctuation, and emoji where legible.
extraction_method.metric_policy: Treat counters displayed beside the post as post-level metrics. Keep sidebar analytics separate because they are account dashboard snapshots, not metrics for the visible post.
extraction_method.zero_metric_policy: When LinkedIn omits a zero-value counter, store the numeric value as null and add an inferred value separately instead of treating the zero as fully confirmed.
extraction_method.analysis_policy: Separate observation from inference. Engagement rates are calculated from visible metrics and impressions. Performance explanations are hypotheses, not causal proof.
extraction_method.weighted_engagement_formula: reactions + (3 * comments) + (5 * reposts). Saves are unavailable in the screenshots and therefore excluded.

primary_topics: AI Engineer to Project Manager transition
caption_paragraphs_verbatim: Dua bulan jadi Project Manager dan hal pertama yang beneran gue pelajari adalah bahwa nge-acc semua request client bukan tanda PM yang responsif, melainkan tanda PM yang belum ngerti tugasnya.

Gue ditunjuk langsung sama CEO Perfect10 karena udah kenal dari awal waktu masih jadi AI Engineer di tim yang sama, jadi gue kira transisinya bakal relatif mulus karena gue tau sistemnya dari dalam. Yang nggak gue antisipasi adalah betapa susahnya secara psikologis untuk bilang "ini belum bisa masuk sekarang" ke client yang udah bayar dan udah excited sama idenya, sampai akhirnya gue dibilang terlalu baik karena hampir semua request gue iya-iyain.

Sekarang gue handle 5 project paralel dan udah nerapin satu rule yang sederhana tapi butuh waktu buat gue beneran percaya diri ngelakuinnya, semua request di luar scope yang udah didefinisikan dicatat dan dihargai tapi baru dibahas setelah deliverable yang sedang berjalan selesai.

Di luar urusan client, yang paling ngasih gue relief justru ngelihat intern yang gue naungin pelan-pelan berkembang ngikutin ritme kerja yang ada. Ada satu momen yang gue inget, waktu dia lagi fixing bug tapi nggak dipisah environmentnya dulu, jadi satu bug kelar, empat yang lain bermunculan. Gue ajarin mereka bikin sandbox dulu, replikasi flownya di script terpisah, eksplorasi di sana, baru implement balik ke project kalau udah beneran fix. Sederhana, tapi setelah itu dia jauh lebih tenang ngadepin bug berikutnya.
Ngejaga ekspektasi client itu sulit, tapi ngelihat orang yang lu ajarin mulai ngerti caranya berpikir terstruktur itu yang bikin role ini worth it.
posts.hook_verbatim: Dua bulan jadi Project Manager dan hal pertama yang beneran gue pelajari adalah bahwa nge-acc semua request client bukan tanda PM yang responsif, melainkan tanda PM yang belum ngerti tugasnya.
posts.landing_verbatim: Ngejaga ekspektasi client itu sulit, tapi ngelihat orang yang lu ajarin mulai ngerti caranya berpikir terstruktur itu yang bikin role ini worth it.

visual.description: A cropped capture of the PERFECT10 About Us team grid. Abdiel appears first in a purple PERFECT10 shirt and is labeled Project Manager. Two teammates appear beside him, labeled Software Engineer and Frontend Engineer.
visual.composition: Three team portraits in a horizontal row inside the company website. Abdiel occupies the leftmost position, making his new role immediately legible.
visual.narrative_function: Provides external proof of the role transition and visually shifts the story from individual reflection to team responsibility.
visual.authenticity_signal: High. It is an actual company-team artifact rather than a designed quote card.
visual.possible_weakness: The screenshot proves the title and team context, but it does not visualize the client-boundary lesson or mentoring moment directly.

observed_strengths: The opening is contrarian but self-critical. It challenges an assumption by admitting Abdiel made the mistake himself.
The story contains a clear role transition with psychological friction, not only a title announcement.
The rule 'Hold and discuss later' is short, repeatable, and operational.
The intern debugging scene turns an abstract leadership claim into a specific moment.
The landing is human and understated. It explains why the new role feels worthwhile without becoming motivational advice.
The post produced the highest reach, comments, reposts, raw interactions, and weighted engagement in this four-post snapshot.

likely_performance_drivers.hypothesis: A broad professional tension made the post readable beyond AI specialists.
Self-implication made the contrarian hook feel honest rather than preachy.
The combination of client management and intern mentoring gave both managers and engineers a reason to respond.
The company-team visual strengthened the credibility of the role transition.

brand_learning: Abdiel performs best when the post begins with a mistake he made and converts it into an operating rule.
The PM transition becomes credible through decisions and mentoring behavior, not through the title alone.
Technical specificity works inside a human scene. The sandbox example is memorable because a person became calmer afterward.
A one-line operating principle can act as the post's spine.
posts.reuse_pattern: specific professional mistake -> psychological friction -> operating rule -> concrete team moment -> understated human landing

posts.working_title: The laptop that could no longer keep up
caption_paragraphs_verbatim: M. Alif R. dari awal selalu bilang ke gw buat manfaatin Claude Cowork semaksimal mungkin buat kerjaan sehari-hari, dan gw ikutin karena emang terasa bedanya, terutama waktu harus loncat project kesana kemari sebagai PM di PERFECT10 AI.

Tapi ada satu hal yang pelan-pelan gw sadarin, Athlon Silver yang udah setia nemenin gw dari pertama kali eksperimen bikin sentiment analysis, ngulik OCR, sampai nyoba-nyoba RAG, ternyata udah mulai kehabisan napas ngikutin ritme yang makin padat.

Paling kerasa waktu masih fokus jadi AI Engineer dan lagi ngerjain pipeline OCR yang butuh Docker sama PaddleOCR jalan bersamaan, laptop gw udah mulai bunyi sendiri, blue screen, dan akhirnya gw bagian refine flow doang, testingnya jalan di device Alif 😂
Itu bukan pertama kalinya dia take over, sampai sekarang gw jadi PM dan loadnya makin nambah, di titik itulah dia kasih gw kesempatan buat upgrade.
Tentunya Athlon Silver tetep ada buat pegang tugas-tugas yang lebih santai, sementara Mac yang sekarang nanggung flow hariannya.
Next lanjut adapts dan pecut Claude🤗
posts.hook_verbatim: M. Alif R. dari awal selalu bilang ke gw buat manfaatin Claude Cowork semaksimal mungkin buat kerjaan sehari-hari, dan gw ikutin karena emang terasa bedanya, terutama waktu harus loncat project kesana kemari sebagai PM di PERFECT10 AI.
posts.landing_verbatim: Next lanjut adapts dan pecut Claude🤗

visual.description: A close photograph of a MacBook Air showing the macOS About screen. The visible device is a MacBook Air M1 2020 with 8 GB memory. The screen and keyboard fill most of the frame.
visual.composition: The laptop is photographed at a slight angle. The About screen provides product proof while the keyboard makes the image feel immediate and personal.
visual.narrative_function: Acts as the physical outcome of the story. The machine symbolizes workload growth and the transition from experimentation to a denser professional workflow.
visual.authenticity_signal: Very high. It looks like a spontaneous personal photo rather than sponsored product photography.
visual.possible_weakness: The About screen makes the post visually resemble a device-upgrade announcement, while the caption's deeper story is about collaboration and career growth.

observed_strengths: The old Athlon Silver is treated as a character with history, which makes a hardware upgrade feel personal.
Named tools such as Docker, PaddleOCR, OCR, and RAG demonstrate real technical history without becoming a tutorial.
Alif is credited directly. The post frames progress as supported by a real working relationship.
The blue-screen anecdote and testing on Alif's device add concrete friction and humor.
The candid device photo matches the conversational tone.

likely_performance_drivers.hypothesis: Hardware-upgrade stories are broadly relatable and easier to consume than niche model-evaluation content.
The story carries several recognizable technical keywords that may have helped engineers connect with it.
Directly crediting Alif created social and relational relevance.

possible_performance_constraints: The first paragraph begins with Claude Cowork and a named colleague before establishing the central tension.
The post contains multiple subjects: Claude Cowork, the old laptop, OCR history, Alif's support, the PM workload, and the Mac upgrade.
It achieved strong reach but the lowest weighted engagement rate in this snapshot, suggesting broad passive interest with less discussion or sharing.
brand_learning: Objects can carry career history. The laptop works because it connects early experiments, engineering work, and the current PM workload.
Abdiel's technical voice remains natural when tools appear as part of a lived problem.
Crediting collaborators strengthens the brand because it resists the solo-builder performance common in technical posts.
A future version would likely be stronger if the workload-versus-machine tension appeared before the product or tool name.
posts.reuse_pattern: ordinary object with history -> workload outgrows it -> collaborator steps in -> upgrade becomes evidence of professional change

posts.working_title: Gemini noticed the anomaly I missed
posts.caption_transcription_confidence: high for visible text, unavailable for collapsed text
caption_paragraphs_verbatim: Riset gue hampir berantakan bukan karena metodologinya salah, tapi karena ada anomali angka yang gue lewatin dan justru Gemini yang pertama kali notice duluan.
posts.caption_missing_reason: LinkedIn displays '...more' immediately after the first visible sentence. The remaining caption is not present in the supplied screenshot.
posts.hook_verbatim: Riset gue hampir berantakan bukan karena metodologinya salah, tapi karena ada anomali angka yang gue lewatin dan justru Gemini yang pertama kali notice duluan.

visual.description: The upper panel is a dark screenshot of a Gemini response questioning why HITL JSON totals are 130 essays for GPT OSS 120B and 128 for Qwen3-32B when the methodology says the dataset contains 150 essays. The lower panel is a dramatic close-up image of a red pencil or writing instrument touching paper while a bright flame burns across the writing area.
visual.composition: Evidence screenshot on top, metaphorical high-stakes image below. The transition from text-heavy proof to fire creates immediate contrast.
visual.narrative_function: The screenshot proves the anomaly investigation. The burning-writing image dramatizes the risk that the research could fall apart.
visual.authenticity_signal: Mixed. The Gemini screenshot is direct evidence. The fire image is symbolic and visually dramatic but less documentary.
visual.possible_weakness: The metaphorical fire may overstate the stakes or look like a generic AI-generated attention image. It is less aligned with Abdiel's strongest documentary visuals.

visible_visual_text_summary.question_raised: Whether essays were dropped because JSON parsing failed, timed out, or produced null model outputs.

metrics.source_confidence: high for reactions and impressions, medium for inferred zero comments and reposts

observed_strengths: The hook opens with genuine stakes and immediately identifies an unexpected investigator: Gemini.
The problem is specific. The anomaly is a mismatch between 150 expected essays and 130 or 128 observed outputs.
The Gemini screenshot provides evidence instead of asking readers to trust a generic AI-assistant claim.
The topic fits Abdiel's reliability and human-review positioning closely.
Although reach is lowest, the reaction rate per impression is relatively strong.

likely_performance_drivers.hypothesis: The hook combines research risk, personal oversight, and an AI system catching the issue, creating immediate curiosity.
The niche subject constrained distribution but resonated with the smaller audience that saw it.

possible_performance_constraints: The subject requires context about HITL JSON, model runs, and dataset totals.
The evidence screenshot contains dense, small text that is difficult to scan on mobile.
The symbolic fire visual may attract attention but does not add factual understanding.
Only 678 impressions makes rate comparisons volatile.
brand_learning: The strongest technical hook is not 'I used Gemini.' It is 'Gemini found the inconsistency I missed.'
Admitting an oversight strengthens credibility when followed by visible verification.
Technical proof posts need one plain-language sentence explaining why the mismatch matters.
Documentary evidence is more on-brand than a dramatic metaphorical image.
posts.reuse_pattern: research nearly fails -> anomaly appears -> AI notices it -> human investigates and repairs the evidence chain
posts.follow_up_needed: Obtain the expanded caption or post URL before using this post as a complete style reference.

posts.working_title: Too much happened to write about it
primary_topics: AI Engineer to Project Manager transition
caption_paragraphs_verbatim: Dua bulan terakhir gue hampir nggak buka LinkedIn sama sekali, bukan karena nggak ada yang terjadi tapi justru karena terlalu banyak yang terjadi sampai nulis di sini selalu kalah prioritas.

Semester 6 ini gue ambil jalur riset bareng dosen buat konversi SKS, di tengah itu juga terpilih jadi Google Student Ambassador 2026, dan transisi peran dari AI Engineer ke Project Manager. Sebagai GSA gue sempat aktif ikut brief konten seputar produk Google dan nyobain Singapore Challenge bikin konten bahasa Inggris, nggak sampe kepilih, tapi ya buat belajar speaking tipis tipis lumayan.

Programnya fleksibel dan gue tetap ikuti di kapasitas yang bisa gue jaga, tapi pertengahan semester pilihan gue jatuh ke hal-hal yang lebih menyita effort, dimana riset yang hampir berantakan di detik terakhir dan belajar bahwa jadi PM itu jauh lebih kompleks dari yang gue bayangkan waktu masih di sisi engineering.
Dua cerita itu masing-masing panjang dan gue mau share pelan-pelan, anyway merch Google Student Ambassador Indonesia kerenn parah 🙌
posts.hook_verbatim: Dua bulan terakhir gue hampir nggak buka LinkedIn sama sekali, bukan karena nggak ada yang terjadi tapi justru karena terlalu banyak yang terjadi sampai nulis di sini selalu kalah prioritas.
posts.landing_verbatim: Dua cerita itu masing-masing panjang dan gue mau share pelan-pelan, anyway merch Google Student Ambassador Indonesia kerenn parah 🙌

visual.description: An open cardboard box containing Google Student Ambassador Indonesia merchandise. Visible objects include a large blue insulated bottle, a branded notebook or folder, a lanyard, a circular pin, stationery, and other printed materials.
visual.composition: Top-down view into the package. The blue bottle dominates the upper-left area while the white branded materials fill the lower-right area.
visual.narrative_function: Provides concrete proof of selection into the program and gives the multi-topic life update a simple visual anchor.
visual.authenticity_signal: Very high. The unboxing photo feels personal and immediate.
visual.possible_weakness: The visual makes the achievement the dominant story, while the caption also contains research pressure and a major role transition.

metrics.source_confidence: high for reactions, comments, and impressions, medium for inferred zero reposts

observed_strengths: The opening explains absence through overload, which creates a relatable tension without manufacturing drama.
The caption names several real developments and acknowledges a failed Singapore Challenge selection without embarrassment.
The merch photo proves the GSA achievement without requiring a designed announcement graphic.
The post maintains an informal voice even while discussing research, role transition, and a recognized program.
It generated the second-highest weighted engagement rate in this snapshot.

likely_performance_drivers.hypothesis: The recognized Google program gave the post achievement value and made the visual easy to understand.
The honest mention of not being selected for the Singapore Challenge prevented the post from becoming a pure victory announcement.
Followers who had not seen Abdiel post for two months had multiple reasons to re-engage.

possible_performance_constraints: The post contains at least three major stories: GSA, research, and the PM transition.
No single story is explored deeply enough to create the investigative arc found in Abdiel's strongest technical storytelling.
The final line deliberately shifts into merch enthusiasm, making the landing personable but less strategically sharp.
brand_learning: Achievement posts work better when Abdiel includes an imperfect detail, such as not being selected for a challenge.
Candid artifact photography is a strong visual language for Abdiel.
Broad personal updates can reactivate the audience, but their individual stories should later become focused follow-up posts.
The post demonstrates that Abdiel does not need formal corporate language to communicate credible professional progress.
posts.reuse_pattern: period of silence -> several real developments -> honest prioritization -> visible achievement artifact -> promise of deeper stories later

aggregate_metrics.caution: Aggregate calculations use inferred zeros for counters omitted by LinkedIn and exclude saves.

cross_post_comparison.main_reason_to_study: Strongest combination of broad tension, operational specificity, leadership behavior, and human landing.
Shows how a physical object and a collaborator can carry a career-transition story.
Proves that recognized achievement performs without polished announcement graphics when paired with honest context.
Strong technical hook and brand alignment, but low distribution and incomplete caption data.

learned_voice_profile.primary_register: Conversational Indonesian using gue or gw, with English technical and professional terms left untranslated.
sentence_behavior: Paragraph breaks carry pacing more than formal subheadings.
The hook often starts with a time marker or a moment of friction.
A short English line can function as an operating rule or punchline.
Technical nouns remain precise even inside casual storytelling.
recurring_story_moves: Introduce a concrete operational or technical constraint.
Name the person, tool, model, or environment involved.
Show the adjustment through a rule, experiment, or changed workflow.
Land on an observation instead of a numbered lesson.
humanity_signals: Uses candid artifacts instead of designed personal-brand graphics.
Includes small, believable details such as a blue screen, a sandbox, or unopened merchandise.
learned_voice_profile.technicality_pattern: Technical details perform best when they explain the stakes of a human story. Dense technical evidence alone appears to reach a smaller audience.
learned_voice_profile.emoji_pattern: Zero to two emojis. Emoji are used as conversational punctuation, not as a visual hook system.
learned_voice_profile.hashtag_pattern: No hashtags are visible in the supplied posts.
anti_patterns_to_avoid_when_writing_for_: Turning the post into a numbered lesson list.
Replacing gue or gw with formal corporate Indonesian unless the context requires it.
Using an achievement without an imperfect or difficult detail.
Overexplaining technical mechanics before establishing why they mattered.
Using dramatic metaphorical visuals when a real screenshot, artifact, person, or system output is available.
Writing in polished English-heavy consultant language that does not resemble Abdiel's spoken rhythm.

strongest_current_pattern.name: Self-implicating operational story
strongest_current_pattern.evidence: The PM-transition post leads this snapshot in impressions, comments, reposts, raw interactions, weighted engagement, and weighted engagement rate.
strongest_current_pattern.formula: I believed or did the obvious thing -> reality exposed the flaw -> I adopted a concrete rule -> another person or system changed because of it.

second_pattern.name: Achievement with visible imperfection
second_pattern.evidence: The GSA post has the second-highest weighted engagement rate while openly mentioning a challenge Abdiel did not win.
second_pattern.formula: Real achievement -> what else was happening -> what did not work -> honest capacity decision -> tangible artifact.

technical_post_pattern.name: Engineer as detective
technical_post_pattern.evidence: The research anomaly hook is highly aligned with Abdiel's reliability positioning and has a respectable reaction rate despite low distribution.
technical_post_pattern.formula: Result looked wrong -> evidence mismatch -> unexpected clue -> human investigation -> corrected system or methodology.

preferred: Actual tool output or analysis screenshot
Physical proof of participation or achievement
use_with_caution: Dense screenshots with unreadable mobile text
visual_strategy.principle: The visual should prove that the event happened or reveal the object that carried the story.

recommended_balance_for_future_posts: Open with a human or operational contradiction.
Introduce technical detail only after the reader understands the consequence.
Keep one story per post when possible.
Use one compact operating rule or finding that readers can remember.
Credit collaborators where the work was genuinely shared.
Close with an earned observation rather than advice.

implications_for_reproducibility_post.reason: The story contains a confusing result, a mistaken initial assumption, a technical investigation, a concrete operating contract, team execution, measurable output, and a professional handoff.
recommended_story_shape_based_on_this_da: Start with the contradiction: the parser reproduced perfectly, but the system did not.
Admit the initial assumption: same scripts and temperature zero seemed sufficient.
Show the specific mismatch: raw images and frozen crops were not equivalent evidence.
Describe the changed operating contract: frozen inputs, model revisions, traceable evidence, explicit gates, checkpoints, manifests, and recovery.
Show the validated result using the approved 189 product, 118 AUTO, 71 HITL, and zero unsafe AUTO figures if client permission allows publication.
Credit Alif and frame the accepted handoff as part of the engineering outcome.
Land on one observation: reproducibility lives in the contract around the model, not only in code or temperature settings.

visual_recommendation_based_on_observed_.preferred: Use a real pipeline artifact such as the HITL dashboard, a provenance manifest, an AUTO versus HITL result view, or a clean screenshot of the validated run.
visual_recommendation_based_on_observed_.avoid: Do not use a generic AI illustration, glowing model graphic, or dramatic stock metaphor.
visual_recommendation_based_on_observed_.why: The strongest supplied posts use documentary visuals that prove the role, object, or achievement.

client_safety: Do not publish the client communication rating.
Do not imply that a later developer replaced the team because of failure.
Confirm permission before publishing product counts, source names, system modes, model providers, dashboard images, or client artifacts.
Scope 'zero unsafe AUTO' to the validated M1 run rather than presenting it as a universal production claim.
